interface.shortDescription: Forge cross-agent skills and agents from a reference library.
interface.longDescription: Source of truth for forging skills and agents that load across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Hermes. Provides access to a curated reference library: the v0.7 skills/agents architecture guidelines, the D1-D5 dependency model, and a dated harness-capability matrix so no skill ever hardcodes a stale harness assumption.
defaultPrompt: Use skill-forge to forge a cross-agent skill or agent from the reference library.
